charts.title: TOI-4495 c: orbits around TOI-4495
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-4495's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-4495 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 5.1830043 d

charts.title: TOI-4495 c: its transit
charts.description: TOI-4495 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (54, 80, 81) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 120826158, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 17 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 11-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 16 min late; 11-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 6 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
